description: User flow and sequence visualization — progressively enhances an ol into a labelled figure holding a nested list drawn as a connected node graph with actions, decisions, and branches

attributes.name: data-title
attributes.description: Diagram heading, rendered as a real heading that labels the figure. Observed.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL to JSON flow data: { title?, steps }. Loaded on connect when there is no inline <ol>, and whenever it changes.

attributes.name: data-direction
attributes.description: Layout direction. Horizontal follows the writing direction (arrows point toward inline-end in RTL). CSS only.

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Reduced spacing and node sizes. CSS only (no re-render).

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the figure when there is no data-title. Observed.

attributes.name: data-label-selected
attributes.description: Live-region announcement on select; {text} is replaced with the node text.

attributes.name: data-label-steps-one
attributes.description: Step-count summary for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category ({count} is replaced). Any category works: data-label-steps-few, -many, -zero, -two.

attributes.name: data-label-steps-other
attributes.description: Step-count summary for the "other" category and the fallback for unset categories.

attributes.name: data-label-type-start
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for start nodes ("Start: …").

attributes.name: data-label-type-action
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for action nodes.

attributes.name: data-label-type-decision
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for decision nodes.

attributes.name: data-label-type-process
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for process nodes.

attributes.name: data-label-type-wait
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for wait nodes.

attributes.name: data-label-type-end
attributes.description: Spoken type prefix for end nodes.

childAttributes.name: data-type
childAttributes.description: Node type (default action). Other values render with action styling and the raw type as the spoken prefix unless data-label-type-<type> is set.

childAttributes.name: data-annotation
childAttributes.description: Note shown under the node; also the node button's accessible description

childAttributes.name: data-branch
childAttributes.description: Branch label on a decision's nested <li>, which holds its own <ol> of steps. "Yes"/"No" get success/error colouring.

properties.name: steps
properties.type: Array<{ type, text, annotation?, branches?: Array<{ label, steps }> }>
properties.description: Get the parsed flow, or assign one to rebuild. Input is normalized (branches default to [], strings become action steps, malformed entries are dropped) and written into the source <ol>, so it survives re-renders and moves.

events.name: flow-diagram:ready
events.description: After every render: initial upgrade, observed attribute change, src load, and .steps assignment

events.name: flow-diagram:select
events.description: Node activated by click, Enter or Space

events.name: flow-diagram:steps-changed
events.description: After .steps assignment (fires after the render's ready)
